summary: Account is brand new with 9 IG followers, 1 LI, 1 BS. Only 3 posts in 30 days — too little data for patterns. IG bio violates rules: niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), timeframe (24 hrs), free offer (site check). Zero DMs from posts.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: **Story** — show a relatable moment (e.g., owner scrolling reels at night, realising script is the bottleneck). Rotate from Question/Contrast/Myth Bust.
- Avoid: "24 hrs", "Rs 1499", "Himachal", niche lists (hotels/cafés/gyms), "free site check", any demo/sample language.
- Posts must read like a developer sharing real work, not an ad. No outcome guarantees.
- First 3 seconds matter: both reels had 64–75% skip rate. Open with a visual/text hook that states the problem in 1 line, no logo/intro.

instructions.research: Find 3 real Indian small-business reels (café, gym, coaching) that use voiceover + text overlay but have weak scripts — note the missing hook, rambling middle, no CTA. Do not name businesses.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two published reels: the '24 clock' reel had 51% share rate despite 64% skip — the speed promise resonated. The 'live preview' reel had 75% skip, 0.4% shares — passive viewing. For script writing, lead with the pain of blank screen, not the deliverable.
instructions.writer: Write a 60–90 sec reel script about 'Reel script writing' service. Hook: business owner staring at blank caption at 11 PM. Middle: show 3-script structure (hook, value, CTA) in a split-screen example labelled 'Example only'. End: 'Pay after you approve the script — DM me'. No niche, no region, no timeframe.
instructions.image: Create a static carousel slide 1: photo of a phone with a half-typed caption, text overlay 'Stuck at the first line?' Slide 2: three bullet frames labelled 'Hook / Value / CTA — example structure'. Slide 3: 'Pay after approval • DM to discuss'. Clean, code-editor aesthetic.
instructions.video: Shoot a 45-sec reel: you at desk, typing a script structure on screen (record screen, no face needed). Voiceover: 'Most reels lose viewers in 3 seconds. A script fixes that.' Show the three-part template. Caption: 'I write reel scripts for any Indian small business. Pay after approval. DM me.'

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & reel scripts for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.' Remove niches, region, price, timeframe, free offer.
Comment thoughtfully on 5 reels from Indian small businesses (café, gym, coaching, salon, D2C) — ask a genuine question about their content process, no self-promo.

Post one Instagram Story showing your code editor with a script template open, text: 'Building a reel script template for any business. What's your biggest blocker?' Use poll sticker: 'Hook / Structure / CTA / Time'.
